documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings Limited reported consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 58.60% year-on-year and H1 FY27 total income from operations of INR 194.9 crores, representing a 47% growth. Management targets over 30% annual revenue growth for FY27 and FY28, supported by robust demand in domestic OEM markets and USA exports, alongside expanding business opportunities in Europe. The company is actively investing in robotic automation and AI visual inspection systems to manage labor dependency, enhance quality, and expand capacity. Capital expenditure is currently financed via internal accruals without availing new term loans. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q2 & H1FY27 investor update reporting revenue from operations of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth of more than 30% for FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: Menon Bearings expects additional consolidated business of around INR 30 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Estimated additional business for FY28 is INR 131 crores.
guidance.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%

guidance.claim: The company estimates additional business of INR 157 crores for 2029.
guidance.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

guidance.claim: Management believes achieving a revenue target of INR 500 crore next year should be possible.
guidance.quote: So INR500 crore, I would say next year should be possible.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: Management considers INR 360 crores to be a conservative figure for annual revenue guidance.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: Management targets growth on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: Management targets Alkop revenue of INR 100 crores for the current year and around INR 125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR 65 crores to INR 75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to reach 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic OEM business grew by almost 50% and export business grew by more than 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing demand from Cummins, generator, AC compressor, and refrigerator sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: So a lot of demand is coming from Cummins and generator sectors. We are looking at AC, a lot of bushing goes in refrigerators and air conditioning systems. We are looking at compressors.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports to the USA are growing rapidly.
demand_outlook.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging despite global business uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is deploying robotic cells to automate machining lines.
capex_expansion.quote: So we are getting a lot of robotic cells where volumes are higher.

capex_expansion.claim: All capital expenditure is currently financed through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: For the Brake division, Rs 0.58 crore was deployed in FY26 with Rs 2.50 crore additional capex planned over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: Five robotic automation initiatives are rolling out between November 2026 and April 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores this financial year to expand bi-metal capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CapEx in Alkop alone for the current year is around INR 4 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer testing machine for the brake segment is expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: And just to give a more deeper explanation, by next month, August end, the machine is supposed to be commissioned at our end.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices increased significantly, with tin up by 72%, copper by 50%, and steel by 12%.
margins_costs.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins typically range between 20% to 22%.
margins_costs.quote: It will range between 20% to 22%, always there.

margins_costs.claim: Segment EBITDA margins are 30% to 35% for Brakes, 18% to 19% for Alkop, and 23% for Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the bi-metal division are around 21% plus and for Alkop almost 21%.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in the brakes segment reached 25% during Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of consumable carbide tools increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects to sustain overall consolidated margins around 20% to 21% over time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

orders_capacity.claim: A recent European tour generated business potential of over INR 35 crores expected to convert into sales during FY28 and FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

orders_capacity.claim: Start of business has commenced for around 54 parts developed for Menon Alkop over the last two years.
orders_capacity.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates almost 16 bimetal bearing production lines.
orders_capacity.quote: There are almost 16 such lines on which we are getting production of various bearings.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in the bearing segment is currently around 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: Roughly, I will tell you bearing around 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined RFQ list for aluminum and bi-metal segments stands at about INR 75 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So, put together, Alkop, that is Aluminium and Bi-metal put together, the list of such RFQ list is about INR75 crores of rupees apart from the potential business that we may get through our visits to Canada and USA, that is different.

orders_capacity.claim: Possible revenue from Africa for bearings, bushes, and washers is around INR 9 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: You see the possible revenue from Africa so far as bearing, bushes and washers are concerned is around INR9 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not taken any term loan for over six months, funding capital investments through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, basically what we have done in the past for more than six months, we have not availed any term loan. Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: Menon Bearings utilizes packing credit facilities from banks at an interest rate of 4.65% to 4.75%.
capital_allocation.quote: Apart from that, we are availing packing credit limit from bankers, which is now available at the rate of 4.65%, 4.75% only.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded entirely through internal accruals without taking fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management anticipates potential manpower availability challenges in the future.
risks_headwinds.quote: So we are not dependent on manpower because manpower is going to be issue in the future.

risks_headwinds.claim: A drought-like situation in Maharashtra presents headwinds for the tractor industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: So that the tractor industry is going to suffer to some extent.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of major raw materials such as copper, tin, lead, and steel have seen substantial volatility and increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: In spite of volatility in the raw material prices, and basically in copper, tin, lead and steel, the prices have gone up substantially.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were delayed in the last three months due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: So actually, our results could have been even better. But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices increased by about 20% to 25%.
risks_headwinds.quote: You see, even after increasing the raw material prices by about 20%, 25%, still, not only we have sustained, but our margins have increased further.

risks_headwinds.claim: Drought-like monsoon conditions in some regions may temporarily impact the tractor segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets revenue growth of more than 30% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that achieving INR 500 crore in turnover should be possible next year.
management_commitments.quote: So INR500 crore, I would say next year should be possible.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving EBITDA margins of about 23% next year.
management_commitments.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans an additional Rs 2.50 crore capex for Brakes over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

management_commitments.claim: Management expects railway brake business to start at INR 5 crores to INR 6 crores in the first year and scale up to INR 25 crores to INR 30 crores within two years.
management_commitments.quote: and with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets Alkop revenue of INR 100 crores for this year and around INR 125 crores for next year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores during this financial year to increase bi-metal capacity by 25% to 30%.
management_commitments.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
